name: Novyra Pharmachem Limited
about: Novyra Pharmachem Limited cultivates, manufactures, and trades tea. It offers black tea, green tea, herbal infusion tea, and specialty tea. The company was formerly known as Bansisons Tea Industries Limited and changed its name to Novyra Pharmachem Limited in January 2026. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Surat, India.
